'''Garu's Warblade''' was an ancient [[Sith sword|Sith warblade]] that belonged to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Garu]] and was made by the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemist]] and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magician]] [[Tritos Nal]]. The [[Sword/Legends|sword]] was stolen from Nal's workshop on [[Korriz]] by agents of Garu's rival, the Sith Lord known as the [[Patron]], and was eventually broken into pieces and scattered across the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
